name: Blue Lock Farm
creator: Finding Illusions
redeem: Launch Blue Lock Farm on Roblox and wait for your plot to load.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Scroll all the way to the bottom of the Shop menu to find the code box.
Type or paste the code into the Enter code here box and press Redeem.
notes:
Blue Lock Farm is a tycoon from the Finding Illusions group, built around the Blue Lock football anime. You open Blue Lockers to pull characters, place them on your plot so they earn money, and then upgrade them or save up for better lockers with higher odds of rare players. Lockers keep opening and cash keeps building while you are offline, so returning players always have something to spend.

Codes typically give Grade Tokens, Trait Tokens, Variant or Jackpot tokens and potions for cash, luck and grading speed. These help you reroll characters for better grades and traits without paying. New codes tend to come with updates such as the weather and traits patches, and the developers post them in the Discord server.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Blue Lock Farm codes?
faq.a: No. You don't have to join the group; the code box in the Shop works for everyone.

faq.q: What are Grade Tokens and Trait Tokens used for in Blue Lock Farm?
faq.a: They let you reroll your characters for better grades and traits without paying. Blue Lock Farm codes typically give these tokens, sometimes with Variant or Jackpot tokens and potions.

faq.q: Where does Blue Lock Farm post new codes?
faq.a: The game description tells players to join the community for more exclusive codes, and the developers post new codes in their Discord server. New codes tend to arrive with updates, such as the weather and traits patches.

tips: Place every new character on your plot as soon as you get it, since placed characters are what earn money. Swap weaker ones out as better pulls come in.
Upgrade the characters you plan to keep. Upgrades raise their earnings, so they matter most on characters that stay on your plot.
Save up for better lockers instead of only buying the cheapest ones. Better lockers give you a chance at much stronger characters.
Lockers open and money builds while you are offline, so log back in often to collect and spend what you earned.
useRewards: WEATHER gives Grade Tokens and potions. Use the Grade Tokens on a strong character you plan to keep, not a starter you will soon replace. Drink cash potions when your plot is full of good characters, and luck potions right before you open a few lockers, so each boost counts. Join the community as the game page suggests, since it promises more codes there.
